title: Work ledger record envelope
description: The common envelope carried by every work-ledger record (PRD §10.3). Records are immutable; a correction appends a new record whose `supersedes` names the record it replaces (PRD §10.1). Authority is constrained by producer (PRD §10.4) — that rule is enforced at append time by the ledger runtime, not by this schema, because it depends on the caller's authenticated identity rather than on the document alone.

id.description: Stable identifier of this ledger record, e.g. `ledger_01J...`.

schema_version.description: Ledger schema version this record was written against.

run_id.description: Run this record belongs to. Every record is run-scoped.

node_run_id.description: Node run that produced the record, or null for run-level records.

attempt_id.description: Attempt that produced the record, or null when the record is not attempt-scoped. Actor identity, graph token, node run, and attempt are separate records (PRD §3.1).

subject_ref.description: What this record is about (a task, a result, a claim). Explicitly null when the record stands alone, e.g. an announcement.

data.description: Record-type payload. Shape is constrained by the record-type schema that $refs this envelope.

provenance_refs.description: Ledger records this one rests on. May be empty, but the field is always present: an absent provenance chain stays explicit rather than implied (PRD §10.5).

supersedes.description: The record this one replaces, or null. Corrections append; they never mutate.

created_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp at which the record was appended.

content_digest.$comment: Computed by the ledger runtime over the canonical JSON form of the record (see internal/contracts.CanonicalJSON and .Digest) at append time. A proposed ledger delta (PRD §10.7) is not yet a record and carries no envelope; it is a separate shape.
content_digest.description: sha256 digest of the canonical form of this record.

recordType.description: MVP record types (PRD §10.2), plus the domain record types registered additively after them -- `grade` (issue #28 item 1) and the clarify-then-commit gate's `dispatch_preflight`/`dispatch_acknowledgement` pair (issue #67) -- none of which redefine core authority semantics.

authority.description: Core authority values (PRD §10.4). No actor promotes its own proposal by changing this field; the ledger runtime enforces the producer/authority matrix.

origin.description: Who produced the record. Identity is not execution (PRD §7): the actor named here is the producer, not necessarily the executor of the underlying work.

actor_revision.description: Producer revision (model build, runner revision, validator version) when the producer can report one.
